title: Desert Daze • A Fun-Filled 5BR Retreat • Sleeps 12
description:
Desert Daze is a stunning two-story home located just outside Scottsdale, AZ. It places you close to some of the most sought-after attractions, while offering a peaceful home base to return to. Relax, unwind, and make memories that last long after the tan lines fade!

• Private, Heated Pool & Hot Tub w/ Lounge Chairs
• Basketball Court & Mini Golf Putting Green
• Karaoke, Pool Table, Shuffleboard, Arcade Games, Foosball
• Spacious Yard w/ Fire Pit, Hammocks, Outdoor Games
• BBQ Grill & Outdoor D

 The space 
Desert Daze is a luxury 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom vacation rental in Mesa, AZ that sleeps up to 12 guests across two thoughtfully designed floors. Ideally located just a few minutes from Scottsdale and neighboring hotspots, you’ll have easy access to top dining, shopping, golf, and nightlife. The property is spacious, filled with amenities inside and out, and ready to host your next getaway!

Perfect For:
• Bachelorette & Bachelor Parties
• Golf Trips
• Family Reunions & Milestone Birthdays
• Corporate Retreats
• Spring Training Groups

Living & Dining
The main living and dining areas are open, airy, and designed for togetherness — with plush seating, a 65" smart TV, and enough room for the whole group to gather comfortably. The dining area seats the full party and flows seamlessly to the outdoor patio, making al fresco dinners effortless. 

The Kitchen
The fully stocked kitchen has everything you need to cook big group meals without a single trip to the store for basics. Counter space is generous, appliances are modern, and a quality coffee maker ensures mornings get started right. Between the kitchen and the BBQ grill outside, this home is built for those who love to eat well on vacation.

The Bedrooms
Desert Daze sleeps 12 across 5 beautifully appointed bedrooms.
• Bedroom 1 — King Bed, Smart TV, Nightstands & Lamps, Desk, Private Balcony
• Bedroom 2 — King Bed, Smart TV, Nightstands & Lamps
• Bedroom 3 — King Bed, Smart TV, Nightstands & Lamps
• Bedroom 4 — King Bed, Smart TV, Nightstands & Lamps
• Bedroom 5 — Full/Full Bunk Bed, Smart TV, Nightstand & Lamp, TeePee Tent

The Bathrooms
• Ensuite Bathroom w/ Shower & Tub
• Full Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combination
• Full Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combination

Games Galore
• Karaoke Machine & Disco Lighting
• Pool Table
• Pop-A-Shot Basketball Game
• Arcade Games
• Foosball Table
• Shuffleboard

Your Outdoor Oasis
Step outside and the backyard transforms into a full resort experience. 
• Heated Pool (available for an additional fee) 
• Hot Tub
• Fire Pit & Seating Area
• Private Basketball Court
• Two Large Hammocks
• Mini Golf, Darts, Corn Hole, & Giant Connect4
• BBQ Grill + Outdoor Dining

 Guest access 
The guest has access to the entire home minus the locked cleaners' closet.

 Other things to note 
AZ TPT License: 21632310
Mesa STR License: 16408

Check-in is at 4pm
Check-out is at 10am

- No pets allowed.
- The heated pool fee is $100/night. The pool can be heated to about 20-25 degrees above the ambient temperature; please keep in mind that when the weather is cooler may not be as warm as you might expect. For example, if the ambient nightly temperature is only 55 degrees, then the pool might heat up to 75-80 degrees. We recommend the pool is heated in the months between October to May each year. We require at least a 3-day notice before your arrival if you'd like the pool heated. Pool must be heated for the entirety of your stay. Thank you! 
- Stays of 28 days or more may incur an additional cleaning fee.
- No parties allowed—violations may result in immediate termination of the stay. We aim to maintain a respectful environment for our neighbors.
- An exterior camera is installed solely to monitor our cleaning team for quality and security purposes.
- Parking is available for 2 vehicles in the driveway. Please note that street parking is allowed, just don't block the driveway.
- If you're interested in a long-term stay, please reach out to inquire about availability
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this property. 

GUEST VERIFICATION:
To help ensure a smooth and secure stay for all guests, the primary guest listed on the reservation may be asked to complete a quick verification process within 48 hours of booking, depending on the platform used to book the reservation.

Prior to check-in, guests may also be asked to sign a Rental Agreement that includes agreeing to our rental terms and conditions and, on certain booking platforms, providing a valid government-issued ID and matching credit card before arrival.

Included with your booking is our damage waiver coverage, which helps protect against accidental, self-reported damage during your stay when reported prior to check-out.
